name: Employer-Sponsored Work and Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: The employer must first obtain a work permit from the Employment Institute (Zavod za zaposljavanje) before the foreign worker enters Bosnia and Herzegovina. The worker then applies for temporary residence approval through the Service for Foreigners' Affairs -- employment cannot legally begin until temporary residence is approved, regardless of the work permit's own status. Temporary residence on this basis is approved for the work permit's duration plus 30 days, capped at 1 year.
requirements.fix_path: Have the employer secure a work permit from the Employment Institute, then apply for temporary residence through the Service for Foreigners' Affairs before starting work.

outcome.duration_length: work permit duration plus 30 days, up to 1 year
